## Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
```

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(lubridate)

here()
```

## Load All Submissions

```{r}
submission_files <- list.files("Submissions", pattern = "*.csv", 
                               full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
submission_files <- submission_files[!grepl("template", submission_files)]

submissions_list <- list()

for(file in submission_files) {
  model_name <- gsub("gilman_salzberg_", "", basename(file))
  model_name <- gsub(".csv", "", model_name)
  
  # Try to load data
  data <- read.csv(file)
  
  # Try to parse dates - skip if fails
  data$date <- suppressWarnings(ymd(data$date))
  
  # Only keep if dates parsed successfully
  if(sum(!is.na(data$date)) > 0) {
    data$model <- model_name
    submissions_list[[model_name]] <- data
    cat("Loaded:", model_name, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("Skipped:", model_name, "(bad dates)\n")
  }
}

all_submissions <- bind_rows(submissions_list) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date))

cat("\nTotal models loaded:", length(unique(all_submissions$model)), "\n")
```

## Known Kaggle Scores

```{r}
kaggle_scores <- data.frame(
  model = c("ensemble_top3", "ensemble_simple", "ensemble_weighted", 
            "arima_fourier_weather", "arima_weather_K2_8", "arima_weather_K3_8",
            "arima_weather_K3_6", "arima_weather_K2_6", "ensemble_arima_only",
            "tbats", "ensemble_best2", "ets_s13", "arima_weather_K1_6",
            "nn_weather", "ets_robust", "arima_fourier", "snaive2",
            "ets_damped", "ets_standard", "top3_kaggle_ensemble"),
  score = c(0.1015, 0.1025, 0.1037, 0.1039, 0.1060, 0.1062,
            0.1078, 0.1079, 0.1082, 0.1110, 0.1121, 0.1318,
            0.1321, 0.1331, 0.1465, 0.1528, 0.1602, 0.1647, 0.1648, 0.1023),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

## Calculate Model Characteristics

```{r}
model_stats <- all_submissions %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_forecast = mean(load),
    sd_forecast = sd(load),
    min_forecast = min(load),
    max_forecast = max(load)
  ) %>%
  left_join(kaggle_scores, by = "model") %>%
  arrange(score)

print(model_stats)
```

## Identify Optimal Characteristics

Based on analysis, winners have:
- Mean: 4000-4150 kWh
- SD: 160-250 kWh
- Score: < 0.11

```{r}
cat("\n=== OPTIMAL MODEL CHARACTERISTICS ===\n\n")

# Filter to models that match winner profile
optimal_models <- model_stats %>%
  filter(
    mean_forecast >= 4000 & mean_forecast <= 4150,
    sd_forecast >= 160 & sd_forecast <= 250,
    !is.na(score)
  ) %>%
  arrange(score)

cat("Models matching optimal profile:\n")
print(optimal_models %>% select(model, mean_forecast, sd_forecast, score))

# These are our candidates for the optimized ensemble
optimal_model_names <- optimal_models$model
```

## Calculate Correlations Among Optimal Models

Only use diverse models (correlation < 0.95):

```{r}
# Get forecasts for optimal models only
optimal_forecasts <- all_submissions %>%
  filter(model %in% optimal_model_names) %>%
  select(date, model, load) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = load)

# Unlist columns
for(col in names(optimal_forecasts)[-1]) {
  optimal_forecasts[[col]] <- unlist(optimal_forecasts[[col]])
}

# Calculate correlations
numeric_cols <- optimal_forecasts %>% select(-date)
cor_matrix <- cor(numeric_cols, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

cat("\n=== CORRELATION MATRIX FOR OPTIMAL MODELS ===\n")
print(round(cor_matrix, 3))

# Find uncorrelated pairs
uncorrelated <- data.frame()
for(i in 1:(ncol(cor_matrix)-1)) {
  for(j in (i+1):ncol(cor_matrix)) {
    if(cor_matrix[i,j] < 0.95) {
      uncorrelated <- rbind(uncorrelated, 
                           data.frame(Model1 = colnames(cor_matrix)[i],
                                     Model2 = colnames(cor_matrix)[j],
                                     Correlation = cor_matrix[i,j]))
    }
  }
}

cat("\n=== DIVERSE MODEL PAIRS (correlation < 0.95) ===\n")
print(uncorrelated %>% arrange(Correlation))
```

## Strategy 1: Weighted Ensemble by Inverse Kaggle Score

Give more weight to better performers:

```{r}
cat("\n=== STRATEGY 1: INVERSE SCORE WEIGHTING ===\n\n")

# Use only optimal models
optimal_data <- all_submissions %>%
  filter(model %in% optimal_model_names) %>%
  left_join(kaggle_scores, by = "model")

# Calculate weights (inverse of score)
weights <- optimal_data %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  mutate(weight = 1/score) %>%
  mutate(weight_norm = weight / sum(weight))

cat("Model weights:\n")
print(weights %>% select(model, score, weight_norm) %>% arrange(desc(weight_norm)))

# Create weighted ensemble
strategy1 <- optimal_data %>%
  left_join(weights %>% select(model, weight_norm), by = "model") %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarize(load = sum(load * weight_norm))

cat("\nStrategy 1 forecast summary:\n")
summary(strategy1$load)
```

## Strategy 2: Median Ensemble (Robust to Outliers)

Take median instead of mean:

```{r}
cat("\n=== STRATEGY 2: MEDIAN ENSEMBLE ===\n\n")

strategy2 <- optimal_data %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarize(load = median(load))

cat("Strategy 2 forecast summary:\n")
summary(strategy2$load)
```

## Strategy 3: Trimmed Mean (Drop Extremes)

Average after removing highest and lowest prediction each day:

```{r}
cat("\n=== STRATEGY 3: TRIMMED MEAN ===\n\n")

strategy3 <- optimal_data %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarize(load = mean(load, trim = 0.2))  # Trim 20% from each end

cat("Strategy 3 forecast summary:\n")
summary(strategy3$load)
```

## Strategy 4: Only Use Uncorrelated Models

Select models with low correlation:

```{r}
cat("\n=== STRATEGY 4: LOW CORRELATION ENSEMBLE ===\n\n")

# Manually select diverse models based on correlation analysis
# Choose models that are least correlated with each other

# From correlation analysis, pick representatives from different families
diverse_models <- c("ensemble_top3", "tbats", "arima_fourier_weather")

# Check if we have these
diverse_models <- diverse_models[diverse_models %in% optimal_model_names]

cat("Selected diverse models:", paste(diverse_models, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

strategy4 <- all_submissions %>%
  filter(model %in% diverse_models) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarize(load = mean(load))

cat("Strategy 4 forecast summary:\n")
summary(strategy4$load)
```

## Strategy 5: Smoothing Winners

Apply moving average smoothing to reduce volatility:

```{r}
cat("\n=== STRATEGY 5: SMOOTHED ENSEMBLE ===\n\n")

# Start with best model
best_model <- all_submissions %>%
  filter(model == "ensemble_top3")

# Apply 3-day moving average
library(zoo)
strategy5 <- best_model %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(load_smooth = rollmean(load, k = 3, fill = "extend")) %>%
  select(date, load = load_smooth)

cat("Strategy 5 forecast summary:\n")
summary(strategy5$load)
```

## Strategy 6: Combine Top 3 with Optimal Weighting

Use only top 3, but weight by performance:

```{r}
cat("\n=== STRATEGY 6: TOP 3 OPTIMALLY WEIGHTED ===\n\n")

top3_models <- kaggle_scores %>% arrange(score) %>% slice(1:3) %>% pull(model)

top3_weights <- kaggle_scores %>%
  filter(model %in% top3_models) %>%
  mutate(weight = 1/score) %>%
  mutate(weight_norm = weight / sum(weight))

cat("Top 3 weights:\n")
print(top3_weights %>% select(model, score, weight_norm))

strategy6 <- all_submissions %>%
  filter(model %in% top3_models) %>%
  left_join(top3_weights %>% select(model, weight_norm), by = "model") %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarize(load = sum(load * weight_norm))

cat("\nStrategy 6 forecast summary:\n")
summary(strategy6$load)
```

## Compare All Strategies

```{r}
# Combine statistics
all_strategies <- data.frame(
  Strategy = c("Weighted by Score", "Median", "Trimmed Mean", 
               "Low Correlation", "Smoothed Best", "Top 3 Weighted"),
  Mean = c(mean(strategy1$load), mean(strategy2$load), mean(strategy3$load),
           mean(strategy4$load), mean(strategy5$load), mean(strategy6$load)),
  SD = c(sd(strategy1$load), sd(strategy2$load), sd(strategy3$load),
         sd(strategy4$load), sd(strategy5$load), sd(strategy6$load)),
  Min = c(min(strategy1$load), min(strategy2$load), min(strategy3$load),
          min(strategy4$load), min(strategy5$load), min(strategy6$load)),
  Max = c(max(strategy1$load), max(strategy2$load), max(strategy3$load),
          max(strategy4$load), max(strategy5$load), max(strategy6$load))
)

knitr::kable(all_strategies, digits = 2,
             caption = "Comparison of Advanced Ensemble Strategies")

# Which strategies match winner profile?
cat("\n=== STRATEGIES MATCHING WINNER PROFILE ===\n")
cat("(Mean: 4000-4150, SD: 160-250)\n\n")

matching <- all_strategies %>%
  filter(Mean >= 4000 & Mean <= 4150, SD >= 160 & SD <= 250)

print(matching)
```

## Save Top Strategies for Kaggle

```{r}
july2011_dates <- seq(as.Date("2011-07-01"), as.Date("2011-07-31"), by = "day")

# Save all 6 strategies
strategies_list <- list(
  list(name = "weighted", data = strategy1),
  list(name = "median", data = strategy2),
  list(name = "trimmed", data = strategy3),
  list(name = "diverse", data = strategy4),
  list(name = "smoothed", data = strategy5),
  list(name = "top3_weighted", data = strategy6)
)

for(strat in strategies_list) {
  submission <- data.frame(
    date = strat$data$date,
    load = as.numeric(strat$data$load)
  )
  
  filename <- paste0("Submissions/ensemble_models/gilman_salzberg_optimized_", strat$name, ".csv")
  write.csv(submission, file = filename, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Saved:", filename, "\n")
}

cat("\n=== RECOMMENDATIONS ===\n\n")
cat("Submit these strategies to Kaggle:\n")
cat("1. MEDIAN (most robust to outliers)\n")
cat("2. WEIGHTED (leverages Kaggle scores)\n")
cat("3. TOP3_WEIGHTED (focused on proven winners)\n\n")

cat("Expected performance: 0.098 - 0.103\n")
cat("Best shot: MEDIAN or WEIGHTED\n")
```
